# The Access Audit

> Independent WCAG 2.1 AA website accessibility audits for small businesses and
> e-commerce, by Aaron Siebold. We deliver a technical conformance scan plus a
> severity-ranked, element-level fix list — not a certification, not legal
> advice, and not a litigation guarantee.

Audits start at $149. Reports are HTML + PDF, written so a client's own
developer can act on them the same day. Automated testing (axe-core) catches
roughly half of WCAG issues; the Professional and Conformance tiers add human
keyboard-only and screen-reader review for the half that automation cannot
judge, and every report states plainly what a scan cannot check.

## Services

Every tier scans EVERY page on the site and walks the whole thing with a
keyboard. The tier determines how much human review comes with that, never how
much of the site is covered. The listed price covers sites up to 100 pages;
larger sites add $0.35 per additional page, capped at $900.

- [Scan — $149](https://aaronsiebold.github.io/theaccessaudit/#pricing): every page against WCAG 2.1 Level A/AA with two independent engines (axe-core cross-checked against IBM Equal Access), plus a keyboard audit covering reachability, focus order, keyboard traps and focus visibility. Severity-ranked HTML + PDF report with element-level fix guidance. 2 business days.
- [Audit — $795](https://aaronsiebold.github.io/theaccessaudit/#pricing): everything in Scan, plus screen-reader review of key templates by a person, image-description quality review, and a prioritized remediation roadmap with effort estimates. 4 business days.
- [Conformance — $2,250](https://aaronsiebold.github.io/theaccessaudit/#pricing): everything in Audit with screen-reader review of every template, plus VPAT 2.5Rev / ACR preparation for procurement, one post-remediation re-scan with a before-and-after delta, and a findings walkthrough call. 7–10 business days.
- [Max — from $3,900](https://aaronsiebold.github.io/theaccessaudit/#pricing): for large catalogues. Everything in Conformance across the whole origin, plus screen-reader review of the full cart and checkout flow at three viewport widths and quarterly re-scans for 12 months. Includes the first 250 pages.
- Remediation is quoted after the audit from the actual findings ($125/hr or a fixed package). Ongoing monitoring, a monthly re-scan with a diff and an alert, is $149/mo.

## What we will not claim

- No website can be certified "ADA compliant" — there is no official certification, and no audit or overlay widget prevents a claim from being filed.
- Roughly a quarter of recent ADA web suits were filed against sites that already had an accessibility overlay installed. We do not build or sell overlays.
- Whether an audit satisfies a specific legal obligation is a question for the client's attorney.
